answer: Fresh-nonce work receipts require every new identity to answer a challenge bound to a live data inlet and a random nonce; identical or previously seen answers are rejected. The valid proof also incorporates a current river gauge value, so an attacker cannot replay a reply after the reading changes. Each identity must therefore run a distinct computation and absorb a short retry spiral as inputs drift, costing each attacker fresh sampling and signed proof generation per identity, plus drift monitoring.
